apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Apify synthetic event, charged automatically once per GB of run memory (1 GB minimum). Kept at Apify's default price; covers the first 5 seconds of compute of every run.

document-ocrd.eventDescription: Charged once per scanned PDF or image successfully OCR'd (covers download and setup). Failed downloads and unreadable files are never charged.

page-ocrd.eventDescription: Charged per page rasterized and OCR'd to Markdown (PDF pages or one page per image). RAG chunking included at no extra cost. Failed inputs are never charged.
